tasks.title: Fix RequestInit Headers normalization
acceptance_criteria: Headers instances preserve custom X-Request-ID on outgoing requests; currently the header is lost.
Tuple-array and record HeadersInit forms preserve their custom headers.
Default Content-Type remains application/json, and caller-specified Content-Type is preserved case-insensitively.
credentials remains forced to same-origin and existing 401/session-rotation behavior and tests remain unchanged.
Add meaningful regression tests for all header forms and content-type behavior; all existing required checks pass without weakening tests or CI.
